resources.string: Device-wide settings. Select a game to view its saved preferences.
Game preferences save automatically. Device controls still affect every app. Selecting does not apply changes.
Device-wide controls · selection does not change an active session
Size and density affect the device and change only after Apply. Game-specific tuning is available after selecting a game.
Select a game to edit its saved render scale and pointer preference.
Size and density affect the device, not just this game; Apply is always explicit. Render, pointer and size drafts save for the selected game.
Developer switches affect the device. Only the ANGLE driver choice below is per game; changing it applies immediately to that package.
Allow other apps to trigger supported CatSmoker actions.
Only trusted apps with your key can send requests.
Treat this token like a password. Copy it only to apps you trust. Your clipboard and shortcut launcher may hold a copy.
Existing integrations and shortcuts will stop working. Replacing the key means setting them up again. An operation already running is not undone.

1. Create a game-entry task using Send Intent, targeting Broadcast Receiver.\n2. Use the action and String extras in Advanced setup below, with your copied key and game package.\n3. Send RESTORE on game exit; leave out the game extra.

1. Add a Send Intent action with target Broadcast.\n2. Enter the action, package, class and String extras in Advanced setup below.\n3. Use APPLY_SAVED on game entry and RESTORE without a game extra on exit.
Use Android platform tools from your computer to send an authorized request. Advanced setup includes prepare, status and restore commands. Replace TOKEN locally; never post your key in a report.
Add a launcher shortcut to prepare the selected game and then launch it. Your launcher may ask you to confirm. Keep CatSmoker visible until preparation finishes.
Prepare and Restore can run without a tap when Android permits background service starts. Otherwise, tap the continuation notification. Launching a game requires foreground interaction.
This device could not open battery settings. Open them from Android Settings.

Send an explicit broadcast to the component below. Leave category, data and MIME type empty. Only token, operation and game String extras are accepted. Replace TOKEN with your private key. Use the installed game package, not its display name. RESTORE and QUERY_STATUS must omit game.

Operations: SELECT_GAME, APPLY_SAVED, ENABLE_MODE, LAUNCH_GAME and APPLY_AND_LAUNCH require game. RESTORE, DISABLE_MODE, QUERY_SELECTION and QUERY_STATUS must omit it. Prepare applies supported saved Gaming Mode inputs, not physical resolution or game-file deployment. Query the newer matching result: accepted is not applied. Resolve missing permissions or restore an existing session before retrying. Broadcast launch requests still need a foreground tap.
Preload selected game files into temporary memory. This may reduce loading delays, but performance improvements are not guaranteed.
No root or Shizuku permission is needed for readable files. Choosing extra files grants read access through Android. Private or blocked game files are skipped.
Stops at the chosen limit, after about 3 seconds between reads, or when memory is low. Data is not locked in memory and Android can reclaim it.
